children: Singapore's economy grew 6.1% in the third quarter of 2026 from a year earlier, government data showed on Tuesday, higher than an official advance estimate of 5.4%.
Economists polled ​by Reuters had expected annual growth ​of 5.6% ​in the third quarter.
On a quarter-on-quarter, seasonally adjusted basis, gross domestic product expanded by 1.5% in the July-September period, compared with an advance estimate of 1.1% growth.

The Ministry of Energy, Trade and Industry also upgraded the city-state's growth forecast for 2026 to around 6.0%, up from a range of 4.5% to 5.5%, with 2027 GDP growth expected to come in at a range of 2.5% to 4.5%.
